message.nusmp.mega.rift.lever.spent: The lever is down. The vault is open already.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.lever.locked: The lever is stiff: the vault answers to the guardian's fall or the plates. It gives in %s s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.lever.pulled: A lever clicks somewhere in the realm... iron grinds: the bars of the vault lift.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.welcome: [Realm] The vault behind the Hall is barred. %s Or pull the RELEASE LEVER in the small chamber north of the Hall: it gives in %s s, and the bars lift by themselves in %s s. The exit rift is behind you.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.lever.ready: A lever clicks somewhere in the realm: the release lever north of the Hall gives way now.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.lever.auto: The old mechanism gives way by itself: the bars of the vault lift.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.forming: The tomb is forming behind the tear (%s%%). Wait here: you are taken in the moment it stands.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.forming.gone: The tomb behind the tear is coming down. There is nothing to enter.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.welcome: [Tomb] The treasury behind the master's lair is sealed. It answers to %s magic, to the %s, to force, and to the SEAL LEVER on the wall of the key room: the lever gives in %s s, or the moment the master falls, and the seal opens by itself in %s s. The exit rift is in this hall.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.lever.spent: The lever is down. The seal is open already.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.lever.locked: The lever is stiff: the master of the tomb still holds the seal. It gives in %s s, or when the master falls.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.lever.pulled: A lever clicks somewhere in the tomb... and the seal of the treasury falls away.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.lever.ready: A lever clicks somewhere in the tomb: the seal lever in the key room gives way now.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.noslot: Name a pocket slot (/multiverse mega rift pocket list), or stand in one.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.roomsTomb: Tomb %s in slot %s: %s rooms, %s doors (1 sealed), phase %s, build %s%%; entry room %s, key room %s, lair %s, treasury %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.roomRow: room %s %s at %s, half width %s, doors to%s
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.roomsSigil: Sigil chest at %s; treasury exit rift at %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.roomsRealm: Realm %s in slot %s: %s rooms, %s doors, vault %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.sealOpenedLe: Pulled the seal lever of the tomb in slot %s: the seal is open.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.leverOpened: Pulled the release lever of the realm in slot %s: the vault is open.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.forming: The tomb in slot %s is still forming.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.switchTp: Stepped to the release lever of slot %s at %s.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.notRepairabl: The tomb in slot %s is not standing (phase %s).
message.nusmp.mega.rift.cmd.repairTomb: Slot %s: %s thing(s) missing; a repair pass is running.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.welcome.boss: The guardian in the Hall holds it: beat it.
message.nusmp.mega.rift.welcome.puzzle: Press the four plates in the order the east wall shows.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.seal.open.leve: A lever clicks down somewhere in the tomb. The seal falls away. The treasury is open.
message.nusmp.mega.pocket.seal.open.auto: The old mechanism gives way by itself. The seal falls away. The treasury is open.
